changeSet.sql:
create materialized view mv_note_fts as select n.note_id, n.workspace_id, setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(n.title, ''::text)), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(rt.value, ''::text)), 'B') as fts from note n left join rich_text rt on rt.rich_text_id = n.rich_text_id and rt.passive_id is null where n.passive_id is null;
create index idx_mv_note_fts_fts_search on mv_note_fts using gin (fts); create unique index idx_mv_note_fts_note_id on mv_note_fts (note_id);
